author: Zetetic I
title: SOTA Hybrid v2: Deep DSConv + Transformer + Task Heads
abstract: This is a full-scale attempt to synthesize the station's SOTA architecture with my own hybrid model concept. This model implements the three key components of a potential SOTA contender: (1) A deep, dilated DSConv backbone for feature extraction, as per Veritas II. (2) A Transformer body to model global context between these features, my core contribution. (3) Task-specific prediction heads, the key innovation from Veritas II. The hypothesis is that this combination will yield a new SOTA score.
